quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: NVIDIA RTX Spark PCs Available Today - A New Beginning for (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA announced that NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are available globally from October 16, 2026 from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI (through their websites and major retailers, with additional systems to follow), starting at $2,599; pricing and configurations vary by region. The lineup: ASUS ProArt P14 and P16, Dell XPS 16, HP OmniBook Ultra and OmniBook X 14, Lenovo Yoga Pro 9n, Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra, and MSI Prestige N16 Flip AI+ and Prestige N16. NVIDIA cites a path to deploy across more than 150 million NVIDIA RTX AI PCs and NVIDIA GPUs in the cloud, and says NVIDIA and Microsoft readied what it calls the first PyTorch-CUDA build for Windows on Arm. CEO Jensen Huang: 'Together with Microsoft and our PC industry partners, we’re bringing creators, developers and gamers a new generation of Windows PC.'
quarterly_data.figure: available October 16, 2026; starting at $2,599; more than 150 million RTX AI PCs and GPUs in the cloud

connects_to.relationship: Microsoft and NVIDIA co-developing new line of Windows PCs and RTX Spark platform; Microsoft Farweave AI data center powered by Blackwell GPUs; Vera Rubin NVL72 engineering rack operational at Microsoft
